subject: VIT_ENOL
courseName: Critical Thinking in Vineyard and Winery Management

response.courseDescription: 494 [M] Critical Thinking in Vineyard and Winery Management Integration and application of knowledge of grape production and wine science to major issues of the industry; improvement planning for existing winery and vineyard operations; incorporation of the principles of economic and environmental sustainability; leadership skill development applicable to the grape and wine industry.
response.coursePrerequisites: VIT ENOL 311; VIT ENOL 340; VIT ENOL 414.
